mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_rca_evidence ( task_id,evidence_id,evidence_type,source_tool,source_ref,coverage_type,coverage_scope, numerator,denominator,control_group,observed_from,observed_to,time_watermark, permission_scope,content_digest,summary,raw_reference,revision ) VALUES ( #{taskId},#{evidenceId},#{evidenceType},#{sourceTool},#{sourceRef},#{coverageType},#{coverageScope}, #{numerator},#{denominator},#{controlGroup},#{observedFrom},#{observedTo},#{timeWatermark}, #{permissionScope},#{contentDigest},#{summary},#{rawReference},#{revision} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE evidence_type=VALUES(evidence_type), source_tool=VALUES(source_tool), source_ref=VALUES(source_ref), coverage_type=VALUES(coverage_type), coverage_scope=VALUES(coverage_scope), numerator=VALUES(numerator), denominator=VALUES(denominator), control_group=VALUES(control_group), observed_from=VALUES(observed_from), observed_to=VALUES(observed_to), time_watermark=VALUES(time_watermark), permission_scope=VALUES(permission_scope), content_digest=VALUES(content_digest), summary=VALUES(summary), raw_reference=VALUES(raw_reference), revision=VALUES(revision)

INSERT INTO t_rca_hypothesis ( task_id,hypothesis_code,statement,mechanism_note,confidence_level,confidence_score, hypothesis_status,supporting_evidence,refuting_evidence,unresolved_refutation_count,revision ) VALUES ( #{taskId},#{hypothesisCode},#{statement},#{mechanismNote},#{confidenceLevel},#{confidenceScore}, #{hypothesisStatus},#{supportingEvidenceJson},#{refutingEvidenceJson}, #{unresolvedRefutationCount},#{revision} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE statement=VALUES(statement), mechanism_note=VALUES(mechanism_note), confidence_level=VALUES(confidence_level), confidence_score=VALUES(confidence_score), hypothesis_status=VALUES(hypothesis_status), supporting_evidence=VALUES(supporting_evidence), refuting_evidence=VALUES(refuting_evidence), unresolved_refutation_count=VALUES(unresolved_refutation_count)

INSERT INTO t_rca_mandatory_evidence ( task_id,requirement_code,requirement_type,trigger_rule,required_reason, completion_status,satisfied_by_evidence_id,failure_semantic,waiver_reason ) VALUES ( #{taskId},#{requirementCode},#{requirementType},#{triggerRule},#{requiredReason}, #{completionStatus},#{satisfiedByEvidenceId},#{failureSemantic},#{waiverReason} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE requirement_type=VALUES(requirement_type), trigger_rule=VALUES(trigger_rule), required_reason=VALUES(required_reason), completion_status=VALUES(completion_status), satisfied_by_evidence_id=VALUES(satisfied_by_evidence_id), failure_semantic=VALUES(failure_semantic), waiver_reason=VALUES(waiver_reason)
mapper.select: SELECT state_version FROM t_rca_agent_task WHERE id = #{taskId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_rca_claim_evidence ( task_id,hypothesis_id,claim_code,claim_type,claim_text,evidence_id, evidence_coverage_type,required_coverage_type,support_verdict,verdict_reason,review_status ) SELECT #{taskId}, (SELECT h.id FROM t_rca_hypothesis h WHERE h.task_id = #{taskId} AND h.hypothesis_code = #{hypothesisCode} ORDER BY h.revision DESC LIMIT 1), #{claimCode},#{claimType},#{claimText},#{evidenceId}, #{evidenceCoverageType},#{requiredCoverageType},#{supportVerdict},#{verdictReason},'UNREVIEWED' FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_rca_claim_evidence c WHERE c.task_id = #{taskId} AND c.claim_code = #{claimCode} AND c.evidence_id = #{evidenceId} )
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM t_incident WHERE incident_title = #{title} AND incident_status IN ('OPEN','INVESTIGATING') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM t_ai_knowledge WHERE source_rca_id = #{sourceRcaId} AND knowledge_source = 'AGENT_RCA' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
